> [!IMPORTANT]
> Expression Flow is not an official Profisee product. Profisee does not support
> it, and it comes with no warranty. Use it at your own risk.

**Build Profisee business rules visually — drag blocks instead of writing expression syntax.**

![Expression Flow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{{REPO}}/{{TAG}}/docs/images/overview.png)

## Features

- **Blocks, not syntax.** 43 typed blocks in 9 categories: logic, string, date
  and time, change detection, conversion, sets, comparison, arithmetic and
  grouping.
- **Live expression.** The canvas shows the exact text that Profisee runs.
- **Round trip.** Paste or load an existing rule. It becomes blocks you can edit.
- **Your data model.** Entities, attributes and related attributes
  (`[Class].[Name]`) come from the connected instance.
- **Data Quality Rules.** List all rules of an entity, load a clause into the
  canvas, and save it back.
- **Chrome extension.** Save your instances, test the connection, and open the
  editor in a tab. No Node.js or web server is necessary.
- **Offline demo.** Built-in demo catalogs work without a connection.

### Two rule scenarios

| Valid If | Change To |
| --- | --- |
| A boolean rule that flags records that fail validation. An optional **When** guard limits the records it checks. | A value expression that sets an attribute. The **When** condition selects the records to change. |
| ![Valid If](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{{REPO}}/{{TAG}}/docs/images/valid-if.png) | ![Change To](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{{REPO}}/{{TAG}}/docs/images/change-to.png) |

### Data Quality Rules

Select the attribute, enter a display text, and save the rule to the entity.
The **Data Quality Rules** section lists the rules of the entity. Click a clause
to load it into the canvas.

![Save a rule](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{{REPO}}/{{TAG}}/docs/images/dqr-save.png)

## Fixes

- **All rules load.** The Data Quality Rules list showed at most 50 rules of an
  entity. It now shows all of them.
- **Real expressions load.** A clause loaded its display text in place of its
  expression. It now loads the expression, the When condition and the
  constraint flag.
- **Entities without rules.** These showed an error. They now show
  "No data quality rules".
- **`NOT` without parentheses.** Expressions such as `NOT CONTAINS([Name], "x")`
  now parse.
- **Parentheses are kept.** Generated code dropped parentheses that change the
  meaning, for example `A AND (B OR C)` became `A AND B OR C`.

## Install

You need Chrome 116 or later.

1. Download `expression-flow-extension.zip` from **Assets** below.
2. Unzip it to a folder that you keep. Chrome loads the extension from this
   folder each time it starts.
3. Open `chrome://extensions` and turn on **Developer mode**.
4. Click **Load unpacked** and select the unzipped folder.
5. Click the toolbar icon, click **New**, and enter the instance URL and the
   client ID.

**To update:** replace the contents of the same folder with the new zip, then
click the reload icon on the extension card in `chrome://extensions`.
